audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the Fish Shop bait and boat-teaser event. All player-facing dialogue, both quick questions, and all five response choices were translated with canonical Community Center and Training Rod terminology while Willy’s nautical, colloquial voice was retained. Event commands, actors, movement, timings, music and sound IDs, branch delimiters, gender selectors, placeholders, emotes, quoted-string boundaries, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
